# 🛸 Hyper Fetch oRPC

oRPC adapter for HyperFetch. Typed procedures with caching, queueing and React hooks.

## 📖 About This adapter connects HyperFetch to an oRPC server through the oRPC RPC protocol. Procedures become regular HyperFetch requests, with inputs, outputs and defined errors inferred from your router through

.

## 🎯 Key Capabilities

- 🔮 **End-to-end types** - Inputs, outputs and

maps inferred from your router or contract
- 📅 **Rich types on the wire** -

and files, encoded by the oRPC serializer
- 💾 **Cache per input** -

are cached, deduplicated and queued separately
- ⚛️ **React-ready** - Use

with your procedures
- 🌐 **GET when you want it** - Opt into cacheable

queries for the procedures your server allows
